concerns.text: Plan Phase 3 commits to 20 independent runs per variant per environment (120 total, seeds 42-61) for statistical power; T014 executes only 5 seeds (30 runs) and T015 is written for an 'N = 5 bounded data regime'. The plan's sample-size element has no matching task; the implementer cannot satisfy the plan's power commitment.

Plan Phase 0b (pilot correlation analysis: 2k-step Baseline runs per environment, Pearson r >= 0.4 go/no-go gate before the main study) has NO corresponding task anywhere in tasks.md. This plan element is entirely uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md (whole document) vs plan.md:Phase 0 / Risk Mitigation
concerns.text: Plan's runner-pinning measures — recording `lscpu` output and `psutil.cpu_freq` per job and verifying < 5% hardware variance as a covariate for SC-002 CPU-time measurements — have no implementing task. Uncovered plan element.

No task persists EpisodeMetrics to `data/processed/episode_metrics.parquet`, which the plan and data-model explicitly require as the input for Phase 4 bootstrapping (SC-003). T014 only validates TrainingRun JSONL artifacts; the EpisodeMetrics entity is uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage vs spec.md:FR-008
concerns.text: The FR-to-task coverage map omits FR-008 (record Success_Baseline per environment for SC-001) entirely, and no task explicitly guarantees the baseline success metric is recorded per environment; it is only implicitly present in T012/T014 logging. Add an explicit FR-008 mapping/task.

T007 requires the schema to include per-step `peak_memory_mb`, but the read-only contract names the per-step field `step_peak_memory_mb` (reserving `peak_memory_mb` for the run summary). Following T007 as written produces a schema that conflicts with the contract-mandated field naming.

T011 instructs off-loading to GPU (`device="cuda"`) if CPU loading fails, directly contradicting FR-009 ('any attempt to fall back to GPU must be aborted and flagged as a failure'). While T003 covers the CPU guard, T011 as written undermines FR-009 coverage for the memory-check path.
